name: Podman Remote Client
description: Installs the Podman CLI and configures it to talk to the host's Podman socket (Docker-outside-of-Docker). Sets CONTAINER_HOST so podman commands run containers on the host. The host socket itself is machine-specific and must be bound into the container by the consuming devcontainer.json (see the hostSocketPath option); this feature only prepares the CLI and environment.

hostSocketPath.description: Conventional path to the host Podman socket. This feature does not declare the bind mount itself (it is host-specific); add a bind mount in devcontainer.json sourcing this path to /tmp/podman.sock.
